phase: 工程案例（Ponder 演示结构）与 A/B

environment.mode: single-player integrated server, real graphical client, creative site 16x10x16

findings: ZwerOxotnik/CreateSchematics hosts real machine NBTs (bread factory, cog factory, andesite generator) but the repository has no LICENSE file, so redistribution is not permitted by default.
createmod.com and similar aggregators accept user uploads with no per-file license; their site code being MIT does not license the uploaded builds.
PlanetMinecraft and CurseForge builds are commonly all-rights-reserved.
community_blueprint_assessment.result: no license-clean community blueprint source was found; files were not downloaded into the repo

ponder_case_feasibility.source: Create 6.0.8.1 assets/create/ponder/**/*.nbt (MIT), same jar as the running instance

millstone_case.power: cogwheel axis=y at [1,0,0] on the side, large cogwheel axis=y at [2,-1,1] below, large cogwheels at [0,-2,3] axis=z and [3,-2,1] axis=x
millstone_case.input: belt at [-2..-1,-1,0] plus andesite_belt_funnel facing west at [-1,0,0]
millstone_case.meaning: the official demo drives the millstone from a side cogwheel, keeping the bottom free for output

ponder_case_feasibility.integration: PonderGuide attaches the extracted case to guide() when the scene asset matches; no new tool group

tool_fixes_this_phase: apply() infers the shaft/cogwheel axis from neighbouring cells in the same batch, so a horizontal shaft run is no longer placed with the default axis=y
after writing, apply() calls KineticBlockEntity.initialize() and sets updateSpeed so placed kinetics join a network before the first read
chute and smart_chute knowledge notes: chutes move items downward only and never lift

runs.reason: model reported that single-block placement never rebuilt the kinetic network; client crashed after the report
model judged shaft-to-shaft and cogwheel rules wrong and stopped early
model reported every engineering-placed kinetic block at 0 RPM and network none
power from below now worked (millstone 32 RPM), but side extraction and automatic stage transfer were not verified; model stopped and proposed a vertical chute chain

ab_result.verdict: case cards did not measurably raise success or lower calls in these runs; the dominant blockers were tool-side kinetic network attachment and the model's millstone port reasoning

generalization: not tested: no successful automatic line to vary
verdict: case library is feasible using official Ponder structures, but it did not improve the outcome yet; keep it and stop expanding the library until a run passes
